durability_preflight.atomic_unit: one (cpu, dataset, model, seed) timing unit in a fresh child process: 1 warm-up + 5 timed training epochs, 1 warm-up + 5 timed inference passes
durability_preflight.checkpoint_path_and_schema: units/<unit_id>/result.json (kind f10_timing, schema_version 1: unit_spec + sha256, every measurement with seconds, images and contention record, peak CUDA memory, host RSS, MACs by two methods, identity, environment, data hashes) and units/<unit_id>/attempt_<k>/{attempt.json, progress.json, child.log}
durability_preflight.resume_command: the same r1/f10_timing.py run command (controller step); validated units are skipped
durability_preflight.resume_validation_rule: validate_timing: schema/status/kind, unit-spec sha256, device, measurement counts per schedule, finite positive seconds, image counts, finite training loss, both MAC methods equal, peak RSS present, CUDA peaks present on cuda, identity equal
durability_preflight.interruption_smoke_evidence: env/smoke_mta/mta_smoke_v5.tar.gz (sha256 CE8D29F3D330D03D..., receipt written on mta-cuda, DELIVERY_VERIFICATION PASS 64 members, 4/4 negative controls): controlled stop 75 after 1 unit -> resume 0 (1 skipped_validated, 1 completed), verify 2/2; CPU path smoke 2/2 with the GPU hidden; CNN two-epoch smoke 3/3 histories byte-identical across two runs; VPS smoke (env/smoke_vps/vps_smoke_v5.tar.gz, verified 19 members): controlled stop 75 -> resume 0, verify 2/2
durability_preflight.max_workers_and_thread_limits: one timing process; torch threads 2; OMP/MKL/OPENBLAS/NUMEXPR=2; taskset CPUs 2,4 (performance cores 1 and 2)
durability_preflight.progress_heartbeat_path_and_stall_thresh: workers/heartbeat_w0.json (+ .jsonl), 60 s; stall suspected only if two heartbeats show no process-tree CPU advance, no inner progress and no new result.json
durability_preflight.heartbeat_cadence_schema_writer_and_atom: 60 s; runner thread; timestamp, run_id, unit_id, attempt_id, pid, child_pid, sampled_pids, phase, phase_started_at, unit_elapsed_seconds, completed/planned units, last_durable_checkpoint_at, wrapper_cpu_seconds, process_tree_cpu_seconds, child_rss_bytes, inner_completed/inner_total; atomic replace + jsonl
durability_preflight.heartbeat_advancement_smoke_evidence: mta-cuda smoke: 8 heartbeats, 2 advancing pairs inside one unit (wrapper CPU max 1.26 s, process tree 5.96 s); VPS smoke: 79 heartbeats, 73 advancing pairs
durability_preflight.opaque_phase_supervisor_sampling_rule: the runner samples its own PID and the measuring child's PID from /proc/<pid>/stat and reports wrapper_cpu_seconds and process_tree_cpu_seconds separately with sampled_pids; taskset execs into python (same PID)
durability_preflight.raw_output_contract: per unit result.json + attempt files; per run environment_w0, heartbeat_w0 (+jsonl), terminal_status_w0; nothing appended to a shared file
durability_preflight.aggregate_script_and_inputs: r1/aggregate_f10.py (sha256 BF7CB9B88892EF52FF8C9B2AFD0D086F5B522E0DAE51CAD6F7B09754E779C698, written before any result was downloaded) over the validated units of the GPU and CPU timing runs
durability_preflight.plot_script_and_inputs: table rendering from processed_outputs/f10_summary.csv only (to be added)
durability_preflight.decision_artifact_path_and_criterion_sch: not applicable: descriptive timing without a decision rule (A11); the ratios fixed in advance go to f10_ratios.csv
durability_preflight.decision_discriminator_statistics_persis: not applicable (no label); every measurement and its contention record are persisted
durability_preflight.recovery_merge_equivalence_gate: merging partial units is not used; a unit is either validly complete or re-run under a new attempt
durability_preflight.opaque_runtime_bound_admission: mode=heartbeat; threshold_seconds=300; evidence=env/smoke_mta heartbeat_w0.jsonl (2 advancing pairs); overrun=heartbeat_or_fail_closed
durability_preflight.per_unit_timeout: 3600 s (child killed, attempt recorded timed_out; at most 2 attempts)
durability_preflight.whole_run_watchdog: controller chain, fail-closed on any terminal status other than COMPLETED/0; ceiling 4 h (A11)
durability_preflight.eta_basis_and_margin: mta-cuda CPU smoke: DANN-LRF 0.68 s and spatial-head CNN 4.09 s per epoch; compact CNN scaled by MACs -> about 25-40 min; ceiling 4 h
durability_preflight.predecessor_terminal_status_poll_rule: started by the controller only when both CNN-arm workers' terminal_status files read COMPLETED 0
durability_preflight.atomic_write_strategy: temp file + flush + fsync + os.replace (r1_runner.atomic_write_json); result.json written last
